votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of: strategy sessions to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation, discussion regarding deployment of security personnel, devices, or systems; and attorney-client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137, and for other lawful purposes that satisfy the pertinent requirements of the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
votes.description: The Council voted to close the work session to the public in order to discuss litigation strategy, security deployment, and privileged attorney-client matters.

votes.motion: Exit closed session and enter back into Work Session.
votes.description: The Council voted to conclude the closed session and return to the open work session.
